title: Mundicunae's Fused Arcana
description: A purple-skinned mystical figure with a green leafy headdress and red gloves sits at a table covered in purple cloth, gesturing over an open glowing book. The scene is filled with magical items including a glass dome containing a red butterfly, glowing potion bottles labeled 'Glass Bloom', 'Veil', and 'Mundicunae', lit candles, and various surreal paintings on a stone wall.
prompt: A purple-skinned mystical being with elaborate green leafy crown and red gloves sits at a purple-clothed table inside a stone chamber, casting a spell over an open ancient book with glowing pages. A large glass dome beside them contains a red butterfly with blue patterns. The table holds glowing potion bottles labeled Glass Bloom, Veil, and Mundicunae, plus green candles. Behind them hang multiple surreal paintings of red roses, butterflies, and gates on a stone wall with purple curtains and hanging lanterns. A large golden circular sign above reads Mundicunae's Fused Arcana.
